## DATA / PRIVACY
Fiscal Week is a business DT → **Pattern A (company AND property)**. Set its privacy rule's first/both checks to, verbatim:

> `Current User's company = This Thing's company AND Current User's property = This Thing's property`

From CLAUDE.md, verbatim: *"Don't write privacy rules that check only company. Must check company AND property on every business DT."* No cross-property visibility; a user belongs to exactly ONE property and cannot switch.

Any write (create / edit / Close) goes through a **private server-guarded backend workflow** — no UI-only or auto-bound write. Note: 19 of 29 backend workflows run `ignore_privacy_rules: true`, so the privacy rule is not a backstop for backend logic — the workflow must enforce the permission check itself.

**VERIFY:** the bundle carries a live contradiction on the permission model — CLAUDE.md/security.md say *"Custom Role DT + fixed Permission OS + per-user extras list"* while design.md §11 / decisions.md 2026-04-17 say *"single permissions list on the Role (no per-user extras)."* For the Task 4 permission check, confirm which model the Close/Edit gate should read.
